item.description:
• New key sounds: pick one under Sound in the console. Tap and Drop are free; volume sits next to brightness and speed
  • Cadence Pro: Scale, Music Box, Mechanical and Drums sounds, with a 30-second preview. Buy or activate from the gold lock at the bottom of the console
  • The preview button now plays the current sound

• 新增按键音效：在控制台「音效」里选择，轻敲、水滴免费；音量与亮度、速度并排调节
  • Cadence Pro：音阶、八音盒、机械轴、鼓组等 Pro 音效，可先试听 30 秒；控制台底部金色锁处购买或激活
  • 预览按钮会按当前音色发声
